name: MOSS-Image-SFT
scope: Low-rank adapters on the six projections of each joint block; the text encoder, the VAE and the timestep path stay frozen. Rank 16 over 400 steps on 288 captioned pictures at 256 square: about 1.8 s a step alone and 19.2 GiB peak device memory; the wall shown shared the device with another run and includes preparing the pictures and judging them. One rank-16 step on the real checkpoint took 3.9 s at 512 square and 14.7 s at 1024 square, at 26.1 GiB peak. Held-out flow-matching loss on 32 pictures from other videos fell from 0.7405 to 0.7326, about one percent, on every picture. Perceptual quality was not measured.
